Just a few steps from our door, you'll enjoy the attractions of Hanoi Night Market on Hang Ngang and Hang Dao Sts (every Friday, Saturday and Sunday evenings) and Hanoi Ancient House on Ma May St, as well as a whole host of shopping centers and banking facilities. We also offer you all the conveniences such as elevator, restaurant, and other amenities expected from a 3-star hotel. Whether you need a twin room, a double room, or a family room, you can find a fantastic value for your money at La Storia Hotel, your cozy home away from home, the place you'll feel happy returning each time you visit Hanoi.
